payload.body: Review of the dispatch-handoff branch established the exists-but-unreadable class for worker-authored documents: a result.md whose NAME is occupied but whose bytes are unreachable — a directory squatting on the path, or a dangling symlink (readTextFile follows it to ENOENT and reports null) — must be a validate finding, never silently treated as absent, because silence passes validate on a run whose result cannot be read. Mechanism: pathOccupied (lstat-based, src/store/layout.ts) distinguishes an occupied name from true absence; the collector threads resultDocUnreadable to the run.result-doc check. Same review also added the misattribution cross-check: a result doc's item must match the RUN RECORD's item (both existing is not enough), standing down when the run record is corrupt since schema.run owns that.
